ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the majority of the fluke surface area, with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixel distribution corresponding to localized scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered white linear and circular pixel patterns distributed across the dark grey/black background, with a prominent white circular rosette in the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at the center-line with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box offset.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible irregular serration along the posterior boundary; right lobe exhibits higher frequency of low-amplitude peaks compared to the more continuous curve of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in jagged, barnacle-encrusted points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white circular cluster (barnacle scar) on the left lobe; dense white clusters of calcified organisms adhering to the extreme distal edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) scattered across both lobes, with a high concentration of parallel markings visible on the right lobe near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization by sessile barnacles (Coronula diadema) forming raised, high-intensity white textures on the trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast white 'target' or 'ring' shaped scar located in the interior quadrant of the left lobe.
